session_timeout_minutes.label: Inactivity limit (minutes)
session_timeout_minutes.hint: A session ends after this long without activity.

lockout_threshold.label: Failed attempts before lock-out
lockout_threshold.hint: Wrong passwords in a row before an account is locked.

lockout_minutes.label: Lock-out duration (minutes)
lockout_minutes.hint: How long a locked account stays locked.

login_ip_max_attempts.label: Failed attempts per network address
login_ip_max_attempts.hint: Failed sign-ins from one address, within the lock-out duration, before that address is refused.

temp_password_hours.label: Temporary-password lifetime (hours)
temp_password_hours.hint: A temporary password that is not used within this time expires.

upload_max_mb.label: Maximum upload size (MB)
upload_max_mb.hint: The largest file a person can attach.

upload_allowed_types.label: Accepted file types
upload_allowed_types.hint: A file of another type is refused.

working_week.label: Working days of the week
working_week.hint: Only these days are counted in a request. A change does not alter requests already sent.

certificate_deadline_hours.label: Time allowed to provide the medical certificate (hours)
certificate_deadline_hours.hint: Counted from the moment the sick leave is reported. A request type can set its own.

certificate_warning_hours.label: Reminder before the certificate is due (hours)
certificate_warning_hours.hint: The employee is warned this many hours before the deadline.

monthly_credit_days.label: Monthly leave credit (days)
monthly_credit_days.hint: Credited to every employee on the last day of the month, pro-rated in the month of joining and of leaving.

credit_start_date.label: Start of monthly credits
credit_start_date.hint: No credit is posted for a month that ends before this date, and none while it is empty. Choose the first day of a month; opening balances are stated as of the day before.

meal_tickets_per_month.label: Meal tickets per month
meal_tickets_per_month.hint: Number of tickets before absence days are deducted.

export_cutoff_day.label: Payroll cut-off day
export_cutoff_day.hint: Between 1 and 28. Leave empty for the KPMG export to propose the last month that is over.
